title: The Tenement Room Where Montessori Counted Forty-Four Repetitions
conflicts: Address: Method misprints '58 Via dei Masi', Vatican News 'Via dei Marsi 58', Montessori Australia '53'; story names only the street. Teacher: Method names Candida Nuccitelli, Montessori's 1942 talk 'a woman of forty'; story uses the name. Ages: three to seven (Method) vs two to six (Montessori Australia); story says 'under school age'. Montessori Australia's 'nearly forty' age is wrong (she was 36) and is not used.
notes: Main sources are Montessori's own books on Project Gutenberg plus the Treccani Dizionario Biografico and Vatican News for independent checks. The forty-four repetitions rest on her own 1917 account and are attributed. Smithsonian Magazine's piece blocks automated requests. Quote stance: complicates (James's 1899 view that attention needs change, set against the girl's repetitions).
